JobMarketplace.remove_job:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Remove the first matching job from the internal job listings list, mutating it in place and raising an error if the job is absent." remove_job]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> job </REF>: any "The job item to remove from self.job_listings."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Access self.job_listings as the mutable list to be modified. RESULT job_listings]
            [COMMAND Evaluate the job argument and use it as the value to remove. RESULT job]
            [COMMAND Call remove on self.job_listings with job to delete the first equal element in place. RESULT job_listings]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: The job value is not present in self.job_listings when remove is called.]
        [LOG "List removal failed because the requested job could not be found in self.job_listings."]
        [THROW ValueError "Raised by list.remove when the target element is absent."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]

JobMarketplace.withdraw_resume:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Removes the given resume from the stored resumes collection in place." withdraw_resume]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance containing the resumes collection."
        <REF> resume </REF>: any "Resume value to remove from the stored collection."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: null "No explicit return value; the collection is modified in place."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Evaluate self.resumes as the target collection to be modified. RESULT resumes_collection]
            [COMMAND Use the resume argument as the element to remove from the collection. RESULT resume_to_remove]
            [COMMAND Remove the first matching occurrence of resume_to_remove from resumes_collection, mutating the collection in place. RESULT updated_resumes_collection]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: The resume value is not present in self.resumes when remove is called.]
        [LOG "The in-place removal fails because the target element cannot be found in the collection."]
        [THROW ValueError "Raised by the underlying remove operation when the element does not exist."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
JobMarketplace.search_jobs:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Search the stored job listings and return those whose title contains the criteria text or whose requirements include an exact case-insensitive match for the criteria." search_jobs]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "Instance containing the job_listings collection."
        <REF> criteria </REF>: string "Search text used to filter job listings case-insensitively."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: list "A list of job listing objects that match the criteria by title substring or requirements exact match."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize an empty list to collect matching job listings. RESULT matching_jobs]
            [COMMAND Iterate through each job_listing in self.job_listings. RESULT job_listing]
            [COMMAND Within the loop, compare criteria.lower() against job_listing["job_title"].lower() and also against the lowercase form of each requirement in job_listing["requirements"]. RESULT match_check]
            [COMMAND If either the job title contains the criteria text or the requirements list contains an exact lowercase match, append the current job_listing to matching_jobs. RESULT matching_jobs]
            [COMMAND After all job listings have been processed, return matching_jobs. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
JobMarketplace.get_job_applicants:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Return the list of resumes from self.resumes that satisfy the job requirements." get_job_applicants]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The current object providing resumes and requirement matching logic."
        <REF> job </REF>: dict "A job record containing a requirements field used for filtering resumes."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: list "The list of resumes that match the job requirements."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize applicants as an empty list. RESULT applicants]
            [COMMAND Iterate over each resume in self.resumes. RESULT resume]
            [COMMAND Within the loop for each resume, evaluate whether self.matches_requirements(resume, job["requirements"]) is true. RESULT matches]
            [COMMAND Within the loop, if the resume matches the job requirements, append the resume to applicants. RESULT applicants]
            [COMMAND After processing all resumes, return applicants. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
JobMarketplace.matches_requirements:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Returns True only when every skill listed in the resume is present in the requirements, and returns False immediately on the first missing skill." matches_requirements]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> resume </REF>: object "A mapping that contains a skills list under the key skills."
        <REF> requirements </REF>: collection "The set or collection of acceptable skills to check against."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: boolean "True if all resume skills are found in requirements; otherwise False."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Iterate over each skill in resume["skills"]. RESULT skill]
            [COMMAND For each skill, check whether it is not in requirements. RESULT missing_skill_check]
            [COMMAND If a skill is not in requirements, return False immediately and stop processing further skills. RESULT False]
            [COMMAND If the loop finishes without finding any missing skill, return True. RESULT True]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
